name: Carruth's Peach Haven
description: In Poplar Grove, AR, Carruth's Peach Haven raises Blackberries, Peaches, and Corn on a family-run farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
